name: External display and casting output
plain: Draws a separate screen on a connected monitor or AirPlay target.
meaning: An app can show different content on a second screen. Mostly a layout feature; it also lets an app know that a monitor is attached.

android.prompt_ui: None for wired displays; Cast and Miracast use system pickers
android.api_surface: DisplayManager, Presentation, Android 14 desktop windowing (Android 16 desktop mode)
android.note: Android 16 adds connected display desktop mode on supported phones.

ios.prompt_ui: None for wired; AirPlay is a system control
ios.note: iPhone 15 USB-C and iPad: external display scenes; iPadOS 16 Stage Manager; iPadOS 26 windowing.

limits.headline: Can show a separate screen on a connected monitor, TV or AirPlay device
limits.user_action: You plug in a monitor or choose Cast or AirPlay
can: Show a different screen on a wired display with no prompt
Show to a TV through the system Cast, Miracast or AirPlay picker
Run a desktop style window layout on newer Android phones
Show external display scenes on iPhone 15 USB-C and on iPad
cannot: Cast or send to AirPlay without you choosing a target
Show on iPhone models before USB-C in the same way
Use Android 16 desktop mode on phones that do not support it
See the other screen's apps or content
limits.differs: Android 16 adds desktop mode on supported phones. iPhone 15 and newer with USB-C support external display scenes.

story.what_it_is: An app can send a second screen to a monitor, TV or AirPlay device.

marketing.name: AirPlay
marketing.pitch: Pitch: stream video, photos and music from your Apple devices to a TV or speaker, or mirror your screen.

marketing.name: Google Cast
marketing.pitch: Developer pitch: let people send content from your app to TVs and speakers.

story.for_you: You plug your phone into a TV or cast it, and an app shows something different on the big screen. The app also learns that a monitor is attached.
story.for_makers: Makers use it for second screens like game controls on the phone and the game on the TV, slide decks and video players. It is mostly a layout feature.

use_cases.example: A party game shows the board on your TV and your secret cards on your phone.
A streaming app plays a movie on your TV while your phone becomes the remote.
A slide app shows slides on a projector and notes on your phone.
A drawing app shows a large clean canvas on a monitor while tools stay on the tablet.
A car display app shows maps on the dashboard screen and a list on your phone.
A sports app shows a live game on the TV and a stat feed on your phone.
A sales app presents a customer demo on a conference room screen.

risks: Can show private content on a public screen
story.android_note: Uses the Presentation API and Google Cast.

technical_bounds: No permission, so any app can read display metrics

history.change: Menu bar and multi window desktop style
